fix(cosh-ng): [shell] preserve login PATH once

Remove the duplicate Bash login profile probe. Accept one bounded,
authenticated startup PATH report from the managed shell before the
first prompt, and share it with Core, provider and audit child commands.
Keep the process-global PATH unchanged and retain inherited fallback
for missing, forged, invalid, late or explicitly disabled reports.

Include the login, transport and input-ownership contracts together with
the profile-only audit status, trace and export regression. Reuse the
existing trusted child-command builder without changing audit argument,
output, process-group or timeout limits.
